exec_summary: Site traffic (GA4, 2026-05-16 to 2026-05-22): growthbook.io had 14,225 sessions and 9,788 users (+17.5% week over week).

**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 14,225 sessions (+17.5% WoW) | 9,788 users
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,363 clicks (-4.7% WoW) | 156,236 impressions (+2.0% WoW)
- **Homepage (/):** 8,480 GA4 sessions (-2.5% WoW) all-traffic | 1,889 GSC clicks (-5.5% WoW) organic | 22,098 GSC impressions (-18.9% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 1,556 GA4 sessions (+25.7% WoW) all-traffic | 99 GSC clicks (+23.8% WoW) organic | 5,900 GSC impressions (-7.2% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 4,732 GA4 sessions (+3.7% WoW) all-traffic | 1,123 GSC clicks (-11.1% WoW) organic | 113,931 GSC impressions (-9.9% WoW)
- **All other pages:** 7,105 GA4 sessions (+46.9% WoW) all-traffic | 203 GSC clicks (-5.1% WoW) organic | 106,498 GSC impressions (+7.4% WoW)

⚠️ Note: GSC page-split dates (2026-05-11 to 2026-05-17) and GA4 dates (2026-05-16 to 2026-05-22) are the same windows reported last week. Site performance numbers are identical to last week's payload. Treat as a repeated snapshot, not new data.

**New competitor activity**
- **Optimizely** published 15 more posts this week — the same vertical use-case cluster (financial services, healthcare, retail, B2B SaaS) that has now appeared in five consecutive monitoring runs. These pages are actively aging into authority. GrowthBook still has no equivalent vertical-specific pages. The window to counter-program is narrowing.
- **LaunchDarkly** "The Future of Agent Configs" video hit 137,732 views (25.9x channel average) — by far the highest-performing competitor video in this payload. LD is clearly owning the AI/agent runtime control narrative on YouTube. A companion blog post **/solutions/run-experiments** and the "Introducing Experiment Approvals" post reinforce a coordinated experiment-governance + AI-runtime messaging push.
- **LaunchDarkly** trunk-based development blog surged +43.1% ETV WoW to 182 -- the only meaningful ETV mover this week. GrowthBook has no equivalent content on this topic despite it being a common developer entry point for feature flag discovery.
- **Harness** published "Taming AI Code Sprawl with Harness Feature Flag Policies" -- AI code sprawl angle directly overlaps GrowthBook's developer ICP and is new Harness messaging that did not exist a month ago.
- **PostHog** "What is PostHog?" official demo video hit 8,866 views (5.6x channel average) -- signals active top-of-funnel video investment in awareness and onboarding content.

**New GrowthBook content**
- Same 10 pages detected via sitemap on 2026-05-23 (real publish dates unknown). No net-new URLs this week. None have GSC data yet -- still too early.
- **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** and **/blog/12-common-feature-flag-mistakes-to-avoid** are the highest-potential pages in the batch for organic capture; neither has impressions yet.

**Organic movers worth watching**
- **"launchdarkly business model b2b"** holding at position 10.21 with 2,429 impressions -- flat from last week. **/compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly** at position 8.5 got only 3 clicks again. Impressions are large and stable; clicks are not converting. This is the fourth consecutive week this query has been flagged with no title-tag action taken.
- **"experimentation platform"** now at position 16.79 -- four consecutive weeks of decline (was 13.1 four weeks ago). Now well off page 2 and drifting further.
- **Comparison pages overall:** 7-day views held at 5 (same as last week, below the normal 12-20 floor for the second consecutive week). **/compare/growthbook-vs-vwo** at 0 clicks again. Worth confirming pages are indexed and not penalized.
- **/solutions/ai** at 0 clicks for the second consecutive week (was 6 two weeks ago). Needs investigation.
- **Multi-armed bandits blog** jumped from 1 to 11 clicks (+10) -- the top organic gainer this week. Suggests latent demand for probabilistic testing content.

**Recommended actions**
- **Investigate /solutions/ai and comparison pages this week.** /solutions/ai is at 0 GSC clicks for two straight weeks. Comparison page 7-day views are at 5 for the second week below the normal floor. Confirm crawlability and indexation before assuming a content problem.
- **Refresh /compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly title/H1 for "launchdarkly business model b2b".** 2,429 impressions at position 10.21 for four consecutive weeks with 3 clicks. This is the single easiest lever available -- a targeted title change takes under an hour.
- **Publish one fintech A/B testing use-case page this week.** Optimizely's vertical cluster has now run for five consecutive monitoring cycles. Each week adds more indexed authority. GrowthBook has no equivalent page targeting "A/B testing for financial services" or similar.
- **Write a short blog post on trunk-based development and feature flags.** LaunchDarkly's trunk-based development page surged +43.1% ETV this week to 182 -- it is one of LD's fastest-moving Tier 2 pages and a natural developer entry point that GrowthBook is not intercepting.
